meta.title: Fomin — websites, bots and scripts, built to spec
meta.description: Websites, Telegram bots and Python scripts. Fixed price, 50% upfront, first 5 orders are free.

hero.title:
A site, a bot, a script —
from idea to launch.
hero.subtitle: I build websites, Telegram bots and Python scripts, start to finish. Fast, no fluff, with a clear price before work begins.

promo.title: First 5 orders — free
promo.text: Building up a portfolio: the first 5 projects are free of charge. The only condition — the finished work can be shown as a portfolio case.

services.title: Transparent pricing, no surprises
services.note: Prices shown are for the base version. Any extra functionality is scoped separately and added on top.

items.name: Telegram bot
items.description: Bot + a simple admin panel — base version. Payments, broadcasts or integrations are quoted separately.

items.name: Website
items.description: A landing page or business site, built to spec. Domain is not included — you purchase and connect it yourself.

items.name: Python script
items.description: Automation, scraping, integrations between services. Exact price only after discussing the task.

items.name: Ongoing support
items.description: Regular updates, fixes and maintenance for a bot, site or script already in production.

why.title: No case studies yet — so I work in the open
why.text: Past projects are no longer live, so trust is built through process, not a portfolio: a clear price, fixed timelines and steady communication.

points.title: Price set upfront
points.text: Cost and timeline are fixed before work starts — no surprises along the way.

points.title: Always reachable
points.text: Viber, WhatsApp or Telegram — quick replies at every stage.

points.title: Stack fits the task
points.text: Technology is chosen for the goal, not forced to fit a template.

points.title: Working result
points.text: You get a finished product you can actually use, not an 'almost done' draft.

payment.title: 50% upfront
payment.text: Half the cost before work starts, the rest once the finished result is delivered.

contacts.title: Let's talk about your project
contacts.text: Describe what you need — I'll work out the cost and suggest a solution.
